title: UrDeck background manifest, version 1
description: manifest.json of a background folder. Unknown keys are allowed so that a newer manifest does not light up red; UrDeck warns about them when it loads the background.

$schema.description: This schema's URL, for editor completion. Ignored.

manifest.description: The version of the format. A background without it, or with another value, does not load.

entry.description: The shader file inside the folder. Default: <folder name>.sksl.

parameters.description: Annotations, keyed by the name of a uniform the shader declares.

kind.description: color only for a parameter with three or four components.

hidden.description: Keeps the parameter out of an editor; the configuration can still set it.

type.description: video is accepted and never played.
